description: Source code for a Spring MVC Controller managing custom product groups in an e-commerce admin panel. Handles listing, creation, updating, and deletion of product groups, as well as managing group memberships.

classes.name: CustomProductGroupsController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing custom product groups in the admin interface, including CRUD operations and group membership management.
